description: This file defines the PumpStream class, which implements a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable, conforming to the StreamInterface. It manages internal buffering, stream size, and metadata, providing methods for reading, retrieving contents, and handling stream state.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: A class implementing a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable, buffering internally and providing stream interface methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes PumpStream with a data source callable and optional stream options such as metadata and size.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, or empty string if an exception occurs.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by detaching internal resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the stream, resetting position and source.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF (no more data).

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception as seeking is not supported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception as writing is not supported.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, pumping more data if needed.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific metadata by key.

methods.name: pump
methods.description: Internal method to fetch data from the source callable and buffer it.
